meta.name: story-long-analyze
meta.description: 长篇网文拆文。深度拆解爆款长篇小说的黄金三章、人设架构、爽点设计、节奏控制。单一深度拆解管道：跑完黄金三章（Stage 1）后产出快速预览报告并询问是否继续全量拆解，确认后从 Stage 2 续跑逐章摘要、聚合分析、设定关系、汇总报告，全程产物落盘 拆文库/{书名}/。触发方式：/story-long-analyze、/长篇拆文、「帮我拆这本书」「拆这本书」「分析黄金三章」「深度拆解」「完整拆解」「系统拆解」或提供小说文本文件路径——全部进入同一管道。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆解爆款长篇的结构、人设与节奏
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想从爆款网文中提炼可复用的写作手法。
copy.tagline_en: Deconstruct hit web novels for structure and pacing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to extract writing techniques from bestselling web fiction.

howto.what: 收到小说文本后,Claude 会按固定流程拆解全书:先分析前三章并给出一份快速预览,等你确认后再继续逐章做摘要、梳理角色关系和世界观设定,最后汇总成拆文报告、文风分析等文档,保存到“拆文库/书名/”文件夹。
howto.when: 你说出“/story-long-analyze”等指令、提到“帮我拆这本书”等说法,或直接给出小说文本文件路径时触发;再次调用同一本书会读取进度、从上次停下的阶段续跑。

howto.what_en: Claude dissects a novel: analyzes the first three chapters, writes a quick-preview report, then on confirmation adds per-chapter summaries, character/setting files, and final analysis plus style reports, all saved to a per-book folder.
howto.when_en: Triggered by commands like '/story-long-analyze', phrases like '帮我拆这本书' or '深度拆解', or by providing a novel text file path. Re-invoking for the same book resumes from the last checkpoint.

say_en.text: Break down this book; the text is at D:/novels/xxx.txt
say_en.note: Backs up the text, then analyzes the first three chapters.

say_en.text: Analyze the first three chapters and how the opening is designed.
say_en.note: A quick-preview report is produced before continuing.

say_en.text: Continue with the full breakdown, don't ask.
